rules.description: C# must be a thin interface only. Zero business logic, polling loops, or state machines in C#.
WebGL uses jslib fetch(). Editor uses UnityWebRequest. Both paths in LambdaClient.cs selected via #if UNITY_WEBGL.
Lambda requires a valid access token. Always check AuthManager.IsLoggedIn before invoking.
Use AccessToken header for JWT tokens, AuthKey header for non-JWT. Detect via split('.').length == 3.
Server responses nest data under 'job' key. Always check response.job.status, response.job.result, response.job.job_id.
LambdaClient is standalone REST. Never require MultiplayerClient or data channel connection.
